name: Sunrider: Liberation Day
summary: Turn-based hex-grid space-opera mecha tactical RPG blending Battleship command warfare with sharp anime bridge-crew banter.
ranking_rationale: Deep challenging turn-based flagship & mecha grid combat worthy of non-adult tactics games (trade-off: notoriously demanding tactical difficulty spikes require careful mech positioning).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.
